title: Very-High-Density Diffuse Optical Tomography System Validation Dataset
description: This dataset contains paired very high-density diffuse optical tomography (VHD-DOT) and fMRI recordings from 8 participants performing functional localizer and movie-viewing tasks. VHD-DOT data are stored in SNIRF format in the first two sessions per subject, while later sessions hold fMRI data in NIfTI format. Preprocessed fMRI data used for comparison with VHD-DOT are provided in the derivatives folder, supporting validation of whole-head optical brain mapping.
methods_description: Each participant completed functional localizer and movie-viewing tasks during VHD-DOT sessions (sessions 1-2, SNIRF format) and separate fMRI sessions (session 3 onward, NIfTI format). Preprocessed fMRI data are provided for comparison with the VHD-DOT results.
